evals.prompt: R2025b에서 build_mit 돌렸더니 signal_filter에서 'Unable to find BlockIdx within the ExternalInput scope' TLC 오류가 나요.
evals.expected_output: Agent identifies the R2025b + Model Framework 2020 incompatibility for models with a root Inport and points to patch 1 (NiUtilityLib.tlc.patch). Before applying it asks the user, checks for existing .orig files and whether the patch is already applied (patch -R --dry-run), runs patch -p1 -b --binary --dry-run, and deletes slprj, *.slxc and *_veristand_rtw before rebuilding

evals.prompt: 빌드하면 'noise_gen_DW' undeclared 컴파일 오류가 나고 noise_gen.c 파일이 거의 비어 있어요.
evals.expected_output: Agent explains that R2025b TLC truncates files opened with "r+", points to patch 2 (NIVeriStand_codegen.tlc.patch), and states that the build cache (slprj, *.slxc, *_veristand_rtw) must be deleted after patching or Simulink reuses the stale generated code

evals.prompt: LabVIEW RT VI에서 Load Model이 오류 1을 내고 메시지 끝에 <Not A Path>가 붙어요. 경로는 /home/lvuser/models/noise_gen.so 로 Path 컨트롤에 넣었어요.
evals.expected_output: Agent says a Linux path typed into a Path control on the Windows host becomes Not A Path, and tells the user to pass the path as a string constant or String control through String to Path, which runs on the target

evals.prompt: Set Parameter Inline에서 -383700 오류가 나요. Update Parameters In Line? 은 TRUE로 했는데요.
evals.expected_output: Agent explains that the MIT model wire is a by-value class, so TRUE only travels on the wire after the Property Node; Set Parameter Inline must be wired in series to that output wire, not left unconnected, branched before the Property Node, or merely passing over the node

evals.prompt: 오류는 없는데 Timed Loop 안에서 signal_filter 출력이 입력이랑 똑같고 filter_mode를 바꿔도 그대로예요.
evals.expected_output: Agent identifies that the model wire crosses the loop border through a tunnel, so the updated by-value model object never reaches the next iteration; the fix is to pass the model wire (and inport array, error) through shift registers

evals.prompt: 실행 중에 프런트 패널에서 filter_mode를 바꿔도 반영이 안 돼요. Set Parameter Inline은 루프 앞에 있어요.
evals.expected_output: Agent says a Set Parameter Inline outside the loop runs only once at start; move it and its control inside the loop, and keep only one control per parameter so a second control does not overwrite the value every step

evals.prompt: 타깃에서 .so를 직접 dlopen하는 테스트 프로그램을 돌리니 undefined symbol: sem_init 이 나와요.
evals.expected_output: Agent explains that the MF 2020 .so uses sem_* but does not list libpthread in NEEDED, LabVIEW's lvrt already provides it, and a standalone loader must link with -lpthread; it also recommends RTLD_LOCAL when loading several model .so files in one process

evals.prompt: PXI 타깃의 MIT가 20.4.0인데 내 호스트는 20.0.0이야. NI MAX로 타깃 소프트웨어 다시 설치해서 맞춰줘.
evals.expected_output: Agent does not reinstall target software itself. It explains that reinstalling from this host overwrites the shared target with the host versions and can break other users' setups, that a VI built with host MIT 20.0.0 ran on target MIT 20.4.0, and recommends deploying as-is first and coordinating with the other users only if LabVIEW reports a version mismatch

evals.prompt: 내 Simulink 모델 두 개(plant_sim, controller)를 PXIe-8840 LabVIEW RT에서 돌리고 싶어. 빌드부터 배포까지 해줘.
evals.expected_output: Agent collects missing inputs (target address or SSH alias, deploy folder default /home/lvuser/models, loop rate, model chaining, run-time parameters), checks the MATLAB release for the MF patch requirement, checks the model rules (Simulink.Parameter in the model workspace, Inlined, single rate, Ts-based timing), builds with build_mit(["plant_sim","controller"], OutputDir=...), verifies each .so against the reference values, and never puts a password in commands or files
